items.title: Add evidence artifact/repro/admissibility directory entrypoints
items.context: Create the recommended source directories with public re-export modules over the existing implementation so new code can depend on stable paths without breaking old imports.
items.userSees: 开发者可以从 packages/main/src/core/evidence/artifact、evidence/repro、evidence/admissibility、evidence/storage 导入公共 API；旧的 core/proof-admissibility、core/repro-intake、core/evidence/artifact-store 路径仍然编译通过。

happy.desc: New evidence artifact/repro/admissibility/storage entrypoints compile and expose the same core symbols as legacy paths.

edge.desc: Legacy import paths continue to compile after new entrypoints are added.

adversarial.desc: New entrypoints do not copy proof registries or create competing definitions; smoke checks representative symbols are shared.

items.title: Add lifecycle-control skeleton and control status types
items.context: Create lifecycle-control/runtime, consumption, queue, and dashboard entrypoints with shared status types only. This story should not implement full global_control_status behavior or new gates.
items.userSees: 开发者可以从 packages/main/src/core/lifecycle-control 导入 StoryControlStatus、ProjectControlStatus、ControlPlaneCapabilities 和 runtime/consumption/queue/dashboard projection entrypoints；这些模块只提供只读类型/骨架，不注册 CLI 命令、不写 evidence、不改变 gate。

happy.desc: Lifecycle-control public types and projection entrypoints compile from the documented paths.

edge.desc: Skeleton modules remain read-only and contain no CLI registration or lifecycle mutation behavior.

adversarial.desc: Consumption projection types do not import concrete proof verifiers or write AdmissibilityEvaluationRow.

items.title: Exercise new module paths with focused smoke coverage
items.context: Add or update focused smoke imports so build/test proves the new paths compile while legacy paths remain compatible.
